name: BASIC PACKAGE
description:
Essential Protection Plan

Reliable and cost-effective pest control solution

This package is ideal for clients seeking an effective and affordable treatment option with strong residual protection.

Service Scope
	•	Non-odourless mist treatment only (slightly pungent)
	•	Fogging of septic system included
	•	Suitable for standard residential and commercial pest control needs

Features & Benefits
	•	Public health compliant fumigant
	•	Effective against common crawling and flying pests
	•	Slightly pungent odour during application
	•	Residual protection: up to 90 days

Re-entry Guideline
	•	8 hours for healthy occupants
	•	24 hours for:
	•	pregnant women
	•	children below 5 years
	•	elderly persons above 60 years
	•	asthmatic persons
	•	sick or immunocompromised persons

After-Service Support
	•	Dedicated customer care follow-up
	•	Free reapplication within 7 days if treated pests persist

name: CLASSIC PACKAGE
description:
Comfort Protection Plan

Balanced performance with enhanced comfort

Designed for clients who desire stronger comfort and minimal indoor disruption.

Service Scope
	•	Odourless mist treatment for interior spaces
	•	Non-odourless treatment for exterior areas

Features & Benefits
	•	Public health compliant fumigant
	•	Comfortable indoor treatment experience
	•	No indoor odour
	•	Fast restoration of normal activities
	•	Residual protection: up to 90 days

Re-entry Guideline
	•	3–6 hours for all occupants

After-Service Support
	•	Dedicated customer care follow-up
	•	Free reapplication within 30 days if treated pests persist

name: PREMIUM PACKAGE
description:
Total Shield Elite Plan

Maximum protection • Zero compromise • Premium comfort

This is our flagship executive pest management package, specially designed for clients who want the highest level of comfort, protection, speed, and peace of mind.

Perfect for:
	•	executive homes
	•	premium apartments
	•	hotels
	•	offices
	•	healthcare environments
	•	VIP spaces
	•	clients who do not want recurring pest problems

Service Scope
	•	100% odourless mist treatment for both interior and exterior
	•	Advanced fogging where necessary
	•	Precision treatment of high-risk pest zones
	•	Enhanced perimeter defense application

Premium Features & Benefits
	•	Public health compliant premium-grade fumigant
	•	Completely odourless treatment inside and outside
	•	Maximum convenience with minimal disruption
	•	Rapid re-entry timeline
	•	Enhanced treatment coverage for hidden breeding zones
	•	Superior comfort for families, guests, and sensitive occupants
	•	Residual protection: up to 90 days
	•	Priority service response
	•	Premium customer support

Re-entry Guideline
	•	3–6 hours for all occupants

Premium After-Service Assurance
	•	Dedicated priority customer care follow-up
	•	Free reapplication within 60 days if treated pests persist
	•	Priority callback support
	•	Preferred scheduling for repeat visits

Why Clients Choose Premium

Because it offers the longest post-treatment support window, the highest comfort standard, and the lowest likelihood of recurring infestation concerns.

This package is best for clients who want complete peace of mind without compromise.
